message: Prettier cannot pass over backend/src without reformatting at least 67 vendored files outside this task's write scope; ignoring them would violate the no-false-green contract, so the task needs an orchestrator-approved contract/scope resolution.

notes:
The scope was already settled in S-0007-8b73 — the missing piece was HOW, so here it is precisely. Your .prettierignore only lists dist and node_modules, which is why format:check still fails; it needs the vendored-source exclusion.

Do NOT ignore backend/src or contract/src as DIRECTORIES. That would also silence every future file added there, contradicting the criterion that all newly written code is format-checked. You were right to hesitate at a blanket ignore.

Instead enumerate the exact drifting files. Generate the list with:
  npx prettier --config .prettierrc.json --list-different "backend/src/**/*.ts" "contract/src/**/*.ts" "contract/test/**/*.ts"
(71 files at present) and write those paths verbatim into .prettierignore beneath a header comment that states: these are pre-existing VENDORED files excluded from format checking only; the reformat is scheduled debt D-0006, due before the next task that broadly edits this source; new files are deliberately NOT covered by this list and must pass format:check.

This is self-liquidating — each file drops off the list as it is formatted — and it keeps the gate real for everything new. It is a recorded scope statement, not a false green: the failure is named, ledgered and dated, not hidden. Contrast the atlasTokens test you correctly DELETED rather than glob-excluded, which would have hidden a real failure.

Everything else you built (eslint.config.mjs, .prettierrc.json, the workspace and root scripts, structural/typecheck/quality/test/verify:ci, .envrc, the CI workflow, tools/quality-gate.test.mjs, and removing atlasTokens.test.ts) is retained — finish on top of it, do not restart. Then make npm run verify:ci and python3 factory/scripts/verify.py green, and negative-control the guard per decision 0009.
